description: This source file contains C# classes and methods related to font selection and rendering in a PDF processing library. It includes snippets for font demonstration, font family construction, and font collection management, with platform-specific code for GDI, WPF, and UWP.

classes.name: DefaultWindowsFontsSnippet
classes.description: Demonstrates font selection and styling using installed system fonts, with platform-specific code for GDI, WPF, and WUI.

classes.name: FontFamilyConstructionSnippet
classes.description: Shows how to construct font objects from font family names and apply various styles.

classes.name: PlatformFontConstructionSnippet
classes.description: Illustrates font creation using platform-specific font families and typefaces.

classes.name: PrivateFontCollectionSnippet
classes.description: Manages private font collections loaded from embedded resources or font files, and demonstrates their usage.

classes.name: FrutigerFontsSnippet
classes.description: Displays usage of Frutiger fonts, including native and simulated styles, with platform-specific font loading.

classes.name: HelveticaNeueFontsSnippet
classes.description: Shows how to load and use Helvetica Neue fonts, including different weights and styles, across platforms.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders font samples and style demonstrations on a graphics context.
